name: Grok
desc: xAI's assistant with live access to posts on X
desc_zh: 可实时读取 X 内容的 xAI 对话助手
solves: News breaks faster than search indexes it, and a press release tells you nothing. Reading X as it happens is a different answer.
solves_zh: 新闻跑得比搜索收录还快，而通稿什么也说明不了。读 X 上此刻正在发的内容，是另一种答案。
best_for: When you want a live read on what people are saying about something right now.
best_for_zh: 当你想实时看看此刻人们正在怎么谈一件事时。
